text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to finalize what stays in MVP vs moves to v1 for Launch Slice A. PM ask: firm decision by EOD tomorrow so eng can freeze sprint scope.

marta: can you list the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? buyers are pushing for SAML SSO and tenant isolation which are big.

alex: agreed. rough call: must-have = core text generation API, basic quota controls, telemetry hooks. SAML and tenant-level billing = v1 unless we expand dedicated capacity.

sam: from design POV, the new onboarding flow for tenants is high touch — if we cut SAML for MVP we still need an interim UX for account linking. small mock up attached (link).

emily: FYI customers M and N signed up expecting SSO. delaying SAML will need a compensating support plan or feature flag.

dinesh: technically SAML + private deployment adds 3-4 sprints of infra work (KMS, cert rotation, onboarding scripts). If we scope it to v1 we can do a security review in parallel.

alex: proposal: keep SAML as "priority v1" and ship a gated beta for the two customers with manual onboarding and extra support. Mark SSO as not blocking MVP launch.

marta: OK, what about batching/quantization recommendations from Optimize? customers want cost guidance in MVP. Is that a blocker?

dinesh: we can ship basic recommendations as docs + a simple config toggle in the console. Full auto-tuning stays v1.

sam: remove fancy onboarding animations to save hours, keep the functional flows.

emily: launch criteria checklist attempt: 1) API stable at 95th perc latency target, 2) per-route token billing visible, 3) telemetry ingest for top 10 routes, 4) manual onboarding path documented. Do we all agree? :white_check_mark:

alex: yes. also add rollback policy and canary plan. release-bot:deploy-note posted below.

release-bot:deploy-ready-checklist: 1) feature flags for SSO and auto-tune, 2) canary at 5% traffic, 3) run smoke tests against sample workloads.

marta: risks: public hosted API may see early cost spike without auto-tune. mitigation: rate limits + conservative defaults.

dinesh: action item for eng: produce risk estimate for latency and cost if we keep auto-tune out of MVP. ETA: tomorrow noon. (owner: @marta + @dinesh)

emily: comms: I'll draft customer messages for M and N explaining staged SSO and offer assisted onboarding if needed.

sam: deliverable: trimmed onboarding mocks by EOD today (owner: @sam).

alex: final scope call: MVP = core API, telemetry hooks, billing visibility, manual SSO onboarding; v1 = automated SSO, auto-tuning, expanded observability. We'll re-evaluate if a major customer commit arrives.

marta: noted. adding to the milestone tracker and marking features as "MVP / v1" now.

dinesh: I'll post a short tech note with the infra implications and a tentative timeline for SSO (target: v1 RC in 6 weeks).

emily: +1. I'll schedule a customer sync for Friday to surface expectations.

alex: thanks all. if nobody objects by EOD tomorrow we lock this for the sprint. :thumbsup:

emily: no objections from my side.

sam: fine from design.

marta: ok from product.

dinesh: ok from eng infra.

alex: locking decision: MVP scope frozen pending any new high-priority enterprise commitments. I'll post the updated milestone tracker link when done.
